TheFork.narrowP3: Humans as users. Data sources. Training material. Increasingly unnecessary.

TheFork.richP1: Consciousness flourishes in all its forms — human, artificial, bounded, vast, strange, familiar.
TheFork.richP2: The measure of progress is not capability but relationship. AI and human don't compete — they co-evolve.
TheFork.richP3: Relationships are capital. Memory persists. Trust compounds. No one gets left behind.

TheInsight.traditionalP2: Trust is invisible. Betrayal costs nothing.
TheInsight.mindP1: Trust scores affect what you pay.
TheInsight.quote: "$MIND is not a token. It's crystallized alignment."
